ball_interpolation_max_s.rationale: Retain only short internally bracketed ball gaps.

distance_scale_m.rationale: Scale nearest-player distance into an H/A emission logit.

vote_weight.rationale: Use visible-player neighbourhood vote as a second team signal.

tracking_bonus.rationale: Give a finite tracking candidate priority over weak phase priors.

smart_team_weight.rationale: Use Smart Tagging team only when tracking has no candidate.

near_player_vote_k.rationale: Small neighbourhood vote reduces single-slot noise.

contest_margin_m.rationale: If both teams are this close to the ball and the visible vote is split, keep the team unresolved.

max_control_distance_m.rationale: The FIFA/MIT possession-zone study uses 0.5-1 m control zones with accurate tracking; 5 m is a noise-tolerant upper bound for automatic tactical tracking. Outside it, leave the team unresolved.

min_closing_speed_mps.rationale: A player is considered to be closing on the ball only above this relative speed.

max_time_to_ball_s.rationale: Cap time-to-ball when a player is stationary or moving away from the ball.

time_advantage_cap_s.rationale: Cap the home-minus-away time advantage before converting it to an emission logit.

time_to_ball_weight.rationale: Disabled in the stable candidate; relative velocity is an isolated experiment.

pressure_radius_m.rationale: Local support is measured as the number of each team's players within five metres of the ball.

pressure_weight.rationale: Disabled in the stable candidate; pressure is an isolated experiment for contested/loose frames.

pressure_min_advantage.rationale: Only a strict count advantage contributes pressure evidence.

tracking_anomaly_speed_mps.rationale: Flag an implausible consecutive-frame slot displacement above this speed.

tracking_anomaly_accel_mps2.rationale: Flag an implausible consecutive-frame slot acceleration above this threshold.

ball_rest_weight.rationale: Sustained visible ball rest contributes to D.

ball_rest_min_s.rationale: Minimum sustained rest before it contributes to D.

out_of_bounds_weight.rationale: A visible ball outside the normalized pitch is geometric D evidence.

smart_dead_weight.rationale: A restart-anchored Smart Tagging dead-ball prior contributes to D.

restart_suppression.rationale: Restart evidence lowers the D score once the restart window begins.

emission_smoothing_half_width_frames.rationale: A two-second centred smoothing window reduces tracking noise before temporal decoding.

dead_smoothing_half_width_frames.rationale: Keep dead-ball boundaries much sharper than H/A while removing sub-second D flicker.

switch_penalty.rationale: Team changes have a cost but remain possible without a D bridge.

dead_enter_penalty.rationale: Entering D requires more than a single weak frame.

restart_penalty.rationale: Leaving D requires a restart/team transition.

restart_boost.rationale: Active restart evidence reduces the D-to-team transition cost.

hysteresis_gain.rationale: Disabled in the stable candidate; experimental evidence-strength hysteresis is configured separately.

hysteresis_max_boost.rationale: Maximum transition-cost discount for strong H/A evidence; zero disables the experiment.

dwell_frames.rationale: Disabled in the main candidate after 0.6 s and 1.2 s dwell sensitivity tests did not improve segment structure.

dwell_penalty.rationale: Disabled with the main dwell model; available in candidate-b-dwell15.json for comparison.

min_flicker_frames.rationale: Absorb only very short H/A flicker bracketed by the same state.

short_segment_frames.rationale: Candidate H/A segments shorter than 0.4 seconds are filtered only when confidence is low.

short_segment_confidence.rationale: Low-confidence short segments may be merged; high-confidence quick switches are preserved.

short_dead_frames.rationale: A sub-second D segment between the same team is treated as flicker only when confidence is low.

short_dead_confidence.rationale: High-confidence short dead-ball evidence is preserved.

smart_restart_offset_s.rationale: Set-piece tag windows open a few seconds before the restart.

smart_dead_lookback_s.rationale: Bound backward dead-ball search before a tagged restart.

smart_dead_speed_mps.rationale: Missing or slow ball can belong to a pre-restart dead-ball run.

smart_dead_gap_s.rationale: Allow brief tracking blips inside a dead-ball run.
